svg.text: Conveyor that scans colour, height and metal, then pushes each object into its bin
ISOMETRIC ENGINEERING VIEW · units ≈ cm · grid = 10 cm · orange arrows = object flow · red dashed = sensor beam · translucent = acrylic
→ Centre objects onto the belt (object entry)
→ Detects an object, starts the scan
→ Flags metal objects under the belt
→ PWM speed control of the belt
→ Swing paddles to shove object into bin
Sensor fusion on a conveyor: vision (colour/shape) + ToF (height) + inductive
(metal) feed one decision. Timing uses belt speed, so no encoder is required.
Easiest to extend to extra sorting rules.
IR break-beam at the entrance sees the object and starts the
Class → pusher number; belt speed gives travel time to that
Servo paddle swings across the belt at the right moment;
unknown objects ride to the reject bin.
